name: Alienor
source:
Queen Alienor is king Louis' fourth wife and the princess's stepmother she's worried about dying young as the king's previous wives. She's unreachable and regal, Kaheroux will need all his guile to seduce her.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1469300/]Steam[/url]]
